services.desc: Marvel at nature’s perfect mix of coastline and mountains on this immersive aerial journey over Southern California. After departing from Camarillo, you’ll soar over Oxnard beaches and the foothills of Ventura County. Then, get ready to circle Lake Casitas before gliding through the serene Ojai Valley. Continue upward into the dramatic Topa Topa Mountains, where rugged cliffs and sweeping vistas define the scenery. As you descend, enjoy gorgeous Santa Paula and the Santa Clara River. Yourself! Light clothing is preferred on a hot day. Wear dark clothing to minimize reflections. There is no age limit. Children aged 23 months and under qualify as lap children.
